definition: Divides the cells of a single-band raster into two classes at the threshold computed from the histogram of the cell values by Otsu's method, which maximises the variance between the two classes, and returns the cells of the upper class as a binary mask.

The old IRI is kept as owl:sameAs. The content of the item is unchanged. Classified clarifying: the item is the same, only its identifier changes.
